name: Steve
subtitle: Work, friends and a growing photography habit.
sessionRead: Three weeks into a new job, Steve is finding a workable week. He has kept his first two work-free evenings, shared three photographs and completed a short workout. He wants to get stronger, keep learning photography and see his friends. Moving the finish line and putting off awkward steps still get in the way.
progression:
Steve has spent years solving practical problems at work. At home he has made his flat usable, found two easy dinners and started a gym routine with Leo. Photography and time with Maya give him things to look forward to.

The new job is interesting, but late finishes disrupted the routines he wanted. He asked for two work-free evenings, shared photographs before improving them again, and tried the shorter gym option.

His current chapter is to protect two work-free evenings each week for four weeks, making room for health, photographs and friends while settling into the role. The main difficulties recur across those areas: adding conditions before something can count, putting off an awkward step, and letting the next opportunity crowd out the first.

chatSessions.title: Making the gym plan flexible

messages.content: I like the push-pull-legs plan, but I miss a session when work runs late.
What is the smallest session that would still feel worthwhile to you?

dailyLog.2026-03-28: I saved the sheet today. I want to keep track of a few things I actually care about: feeling stronger, making photographs and seeing friends.
dailyLog.2026-04-26: Maya and Leo came for dinner. The room still needs a shelf, but we had somewhere comfortable to sit and nobody cared about the boxes.
dailyLog.2026-05-18: The kitchen and paperwork finally have homes. I can find what I need without spending Saturday looking for it.
dailyLog.2026-06-06: Leo helped me choose a push, pull and legs plan. Three visits a week is the aim. I want to get stronger without spending every evening there.
dailyLog.2026-06-14: I did all three sessions this week. The last sets were hard, but carrying the shopping home already feels a little easier.
dailyLog.2026-07-09: I made a reading corner by the window. The desk is usable now; I would like to keep it that way rather than starting another sorting project.
dailyLog.2026-07-12: I had lunch with my sister. It was good to hear how she is doing without trying to squeeze the visit between two other plans.
dailyLog.2026-07-19: The bean stew and tray bake both worked. I saved the ingredients in one shopping list. Knowing what to cook is making weeknights easier.
dailyLog.2026-08-02: I checked my bills and cancelled a subscription I was not using. The next step is keeping enough aside for the next month, not designing the perfect budget.
dailyLog.2026-08-23: Maya and Leo came over for games. I liked having people here. We kept it simple and everyone wants another evening soon.
dailyLog.2026-08-28: I wanted this job and I am glad I took it. There was a lot to learn on the first day. Tonight I want an easy dinner and to tell Leo how it went.
